intro: Krispy Kreme is the doughnut chain famous for its melt-in-your-mouth Original Glazed, made fresh on the glazing line you can watch in store, and the 'Hot Light' that signals warm doughnuts. Beyond the glazed classic there are chocolate iced, filled and specialty doughnuts, poppable Doughnut Dots, and a full coffee and Kreme chiller lineup. Below is the full Krispy Kreme menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A single Original Glazed at Krispy Kreme is about $2.19, and a dozen Original Glazed is $16.99 to $17.99. A build-your-own dozen runs about $19.49, specialty dozens around $21.99, and Doughnut Dots (24) are $7.79. Coffee starts at about $2.49 and a latte is $4.49. The Original Glazed is the icon. One is about 190 calories.

faqs.q: How much is a dozen Krispy Kreme doughnuts?
faqs.a: A dozen Original Glazed is about $16.99 to $17.99, far cheaper per doughnut than singles ($2.19 each). A build-your-own dozen runs about $19.49 and a specialty dozen around $21.99. City-center and airport shops cost more.

faqs.q: What does the Krispy Kreme Hot Light mean?
faqs.a: The 'Hot Light' is a neon sign in the window that comes on when fresh Original Glazed doughnuts are coming off the glazing line. When it is lit, the doughnuts are warm, and shops often hand out a free Original Glazed.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Krispy Kreme Original Glazed?
faqs.a: An Original Glazed doughnut is about 190 calories. Chocolate iced and filled varieties run higher, roughly 240 to 350 depending on the icing and filling. It is one of the lighter doughnuts for its size because it is so airy.
Doughnut Dots are Krispy Kreme's bite-size doughnut holes, sold in packs of about 10 for $4.99 or a bucket of 24 for $7.79. They are poppable glazed minis, good for sharing.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Krispy Kreme?
faqs.a: The best known are the Original Glazed, a dozen Original Glazed, the Chocolate Iced Glazed, the Glazed Kreme Filled, and the Doughnut Dots.
